title: All-electric camping gets a solar upgrade: The 2027 Pebble Flow
gist: Pebble's all-electric Flow travel trailer gets a 2027 update: its 45 kWh LFP pack can now take up to 4 kW of solar (adding 2 kWh of portable panels), a 40 kW tow-assist boost mode, and Nvidia Orin-based self-hitching and remote parking, at $159,000-$189,000.

insights.claim: Ars' automotive editor argues there is pent-up demand for electrified camping, driven partly by annoyance with generator noise at campsites, and evidenced by reader requests for electric camper-van conversions.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Quiet, generator-free camping is a real consumer pull for EV-adjacent RV products, though the category is still thin and fragile.
insights.quote: There is, I think, a pent-up demand for bringing electrification to camping.
insights.locator: There is, I think, a pent-up

insights.claim: The electrified RV/trailer category has a mixed track record: Kia and Winnebago showed concepts, VW is adding a camper trim to the ID. Buzz, while Colorado Teardrop failed and other electrified trailers remain in development.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Startup mortality in electric trailers is high; incumbents mostly remain at concept stage.
insights.quote: Colorado Teardrop sadly didn’t make it, and some other electrified trailers remain in development.
insights.locator: Certainly, any time we cover an electric

insights.claim: The 2027 Pebble Flow's 45 kWh LFP battery can be recharged by up to 4 kW of solar, which Pebble claims generates more electricity than an average camping day consumes; the new kit adds 2 kWh via four portable panels to the optional 1.1 kWh roof panel.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Claimed solar self-sufficiency makes the trailer an off-grid energy node rather than just an EV load.
insights.quote: 45 kWh LFP battery pack that, for 2027, can be recharged by up to 4 kW of solar panels

insights.claim: The Flow's battery is bidirectional with up to 12 kW output (enough to charge an EV in a pinch), AC charges at 6.6 kW, DC fast charges 0-80% in under an hour, and regenerates up to 42 kW through in-wheel motors.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Bidirectional, DC-fast-chargeable trailers blur the line between RVs and mobile energy storage.
insights.quote: the LFP battery is bidirectional, with an output of up to 12 kW, which means you can even use it to charge your EV in a pinch.
insights.locator: Usefully, the LFP battery is bidirectional

insights.claim: For 2027 Pebble added a boost setting to the in-wheel motor tow assist, delivering 54 hp (40 kW) of propulsion instead of merely easing slack, which reduces the burden on the towing vehicle.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Powered trailers can mitigate the range penalty EVs suffer when towing, a key barrier to EV towing adoption.
insights.quote: Pebble has added a boost setting to this assist, which provides 54 hp (40 kW) of assistance
insights.locator: If you don’t want to wait several days

insights.claim: The Flow uses an Nvidia Orin processor and four surround cameras with its powered wheels to self-couple to a hitch ball and be maneuvered remotely via an iPad app, including remote black-water dumping.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Automotive-grade AI compute (Nvidia Orin) is diffusing into adjacent niche vehicles like trailers.
insights.quote: The onboard Nvidia Orin processor and four surround cameras, plus those powered wheels, mean that the Flow can see your hitch ball and couple itself
insights.locator: This being the mid-2020s, of course

insights.claim: The Flow is priced at $159,000 for the Magic Pack and $189,000 for the Founders Edition, placing it far above budget travel trailers.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: At this price point the addressable market is a small luxury niche, limiting volume for electric trailers.
insights.quote: it starts at $159,000 for the Magic Pack or $189,000 for the Founders Edition.
